name: Danielle Rubio
reason: Health restore, re-read 12 Nov 2026: still out, now on the therapy-scope rule rather than the health rule. Her own site (danielle-rubio.com, robots.txt 404 = no rules) is titled 'Somatic Therapy & Nervous System Healing' and presents her SomaLumos Method as trauma therapy: releasing stored trauma with TRE, dance therapy and memory reprocessing, where 'mindfulness meet[s] modern trauma therapy' and 'true somatic therapy' goes beyond approaches that only talk about the past; it is aimed at women who 'tried therapy… but still feel stuck', which also edges onto the 'better than therapy' line. Dzogchen mindfulness is one ingredient, but the work as a whole is trauma treatment (psychotherapy-type work, a scope rule). Email danielle@danielle-rubio.com is published on the home page.
